commit.message:
Bind the constructed rank to exact binary population and a strict growth bound

Use the same native packing, literal adjusted masks and once-shifted source high port to identify an ordinary natural four-block rank. Derive its exact population from both masks, and prove rank at least q cubed and greater than twice the binary window without Pell assumptions.

Record final sequential capped main/check replay and independent isolated review with eight standard-only audits and byte-identical objects. Keep rank congruence, forced temporal exponentiation, and remaining positive source/Pell witnesses explicitly separate.

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentNativePacking2011
+import DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulation
+import DiophantineConsistency.NativeRankVariation
+
+/-! Exact population of the actual constructed rank, before Pell witnesses.
+The source high-mask port contains its beta shift exactly once. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPackingRank2011
+
+open Jones1982 CurrentMasks2011 CurrentWordScalarWitness2011
+  CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordCopies2011 NativeMaskPopulation
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+theorem q_binary (N : ℕ) : q N = 2^(width*N) := by
+  unfold q radix width
+  rw [← pow_mul]
+  congr 1
+  ring
+
+/-- The rank uses the actual once-shifted fourth source port. -/
+def rank (N C F : ℕ) : ℤ :=
+  NativeRankVariation.windowRank (q N : ℤ) C F lowPort (highPort+beta : ℕ)
+    (repunit width N)
+
+def fourBlocks (N C F : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  (C-1)+(lowPort*repunit width N+1)+q N*(F+(highPort*repunit width N-1))+
+    q N^2*(q N-C)+q N^3*(q N-F-1)
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
+
+theorem repeated_mask_bounds :
+    lowPort*repunit width N+1 < q N ∧ highPort*repunit width N-1 < q N := by
+  have hJ := CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_pos (N:=N)
+  have hb := CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_balance (N:=N)
+  have hL := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right lowPort_lt hJ
+  have hH := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right highPort_lt hJ
+  omega
+
+theorem repeated_mask_population :
+    σ 2 (lowPort*repunit width N+1)+σ 2 (highPort*repunit width N-1) = width*N+2 := by
+  have hL : lowPort < radix^2011 := by have := lowPort_lt; unfold beta at this; omega
+  have hH : highPort < radix^2011 := by have := highPort_lt; unfold beta at this; omega
+  have hLB : lowPort < 2^width := by simpa only [radix,width,pow_mul] using hL
+  have hHB : highPort < 2^width := by simpa only [radix,width,pow_mul] using hH
+  exact repeated_native_mask_population (by decide) (NeZero.pos N)
+    hLB hHB lowPort_even highPort_four population
+
+/-- Ordinary integer binding is proved after every natural subtraction's domain. -/
+theorem fourBlocks_cast (C F : ℕ) (hC : 0<C) (hCF : C+F<q N) :
+    (fourBlocks N C F : ℤ) = rank N C F := by
+  have hJ := CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_pos (N:=N)
+  have hHJ : 1 ≤ highPort*repunit width N := Nat.mul_pos highPort_pos hJ
+  have hCq : C ≤ q N := by omega
+  have hFq : F+1 ≤ q N := by omega
+  have hb := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ))
+    (CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_balance (N:=N))
+  push_cast at hb
+  have hbeta : (beta : ℤ)*repunit width N = (q N : ℤ)-1 := by omega
+  have hh := NativeSourceMask.packing_four_block (C:=(C:ℤ)) (F:=(F:ℤ))
+    (MC:=(lowPort:ℤ)) (MF:=(highPort:ℤ)) hbeta
+  have hB : (fourBlocks N C F : ℤ) =
+      ((C : ℤ)-1)+((lowPort : ℤ)*repunit width N+1)+
+      (q N : ℤ)*(F+((highPort : ℤ)*repunit width N-1))+
+      (q N : ℤ)^2*((q N : ℤ)-C)+(q N : ℤ)^3*((q N : ℤ)-F-1) := by
+    unfold fourBlocks
+    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ C),Nat.cast_sub hHJ,
+      Nat.cast_sub hCq,Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ q N-F),
+      Nat.cast_sub (by omega : F ≤ q N)]
+    ring
+  rw [hB,← hh]
+  unfold rank NativeRankVariation.windowRank
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+omit [NeZero N] in
+/-- The positive complement in the top block supplies a large rank before
+any population or Pell premise is used. -/
+theorem fourBlocks_ge_cube (C F : ℕ) (hC : 0<C) (hCF : C+F<q N) :
+    q N^3 ≤ fourBlocks N C F := by
+  have ht : 1 ≤ q N-F-1 := by omega
+  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (q N^3) ht
+  simp only [Nat.mul_one] at hm
+  unfold fourBlocks
+  omega
+
+theorem rank_gt_twice_window (C F : ℕ) (hC : 0<C) (hCF : C+F<q N) :
+    (2*(width*N) : ℕ) < rank N C F := by
+  have hu : width*N < q N := by rw [q_binary]; exact Nat.lt_two_pow_self
+  have hw : 0 < width*N := Nat.mul_pos (by decide) (NeZero.pos N)
+  have hq : 2 ≤ q N := by omega
+  have hsq : 2 ≤ q N^2 := by nlinarith
+  have hc : 2*(width*N) < q N^3 := by
+    calc
+      2*(width*N) < 2*q N := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu (by decide)
+      _ ≤ q N^3 := by rw [pow_succ]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (q N) hsq
+  have hn := hc.trans_le (fourBlocks_ge_cube C F hC hCF)
+  have hz : ((2*(width*N) : ℕ) : ℤ) < (fourBlocks N C F : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
+  rwa [fourBlocks_cast C F hC hCF] at hz
+
+theorem fourBlocks_population (C F : ℕ) (hC : 0<C) (hCF : C+F<q N)
+    (hmC : (C-1) &&& (lowPort*repunit width N+1) = 0)
+    (hmF : F &&& (highPort*repunit width N-1) = 0) :
+    σ 2 (fourBlocks N C F) = 3*(width*N)+2 := by
+  obtain ⟨hM,hH⟩ := repeated_mask_bounds (N:=N)
+  have hA : C-1 < q N := by omega
+  have hF : F < q N := by omega
+  have hh := NativePackingPopulation.calibrated_population
+    (u:=width*N) (A:=C-1) (F:=F)
+    (M:=lowPort*repunit width N+1) (H:=highPort*repunit width N-1)
+    (by simpa only [q_binary] using hA)
+    (by simpa only [q_binary] using hF)
+    (by simpa only [q_binary] using hM)
+    (by simpa only [q_binary] using hH)
+    hmC hmF repeated_mask_population
+  have he : q N-1-(C-1) = q N-C := by omega
+  rw [← q_binary,he] at hh
+  simpa only [fourBlocks,Nat.sub_sub,Nat.add_comm 1 F] using hh
+
+/-- The same constructed packing has the exact population required by the
+remaining Pell construction. No source-system zero or population is assumed. -/
+theorem packing_rank_population (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s : ℕ) (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy s k digits) :
+    ∃ R : ℕ,
+      (R : ℤ) = rank N (source a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N)))
+        (normalized digits) ∧ σ 2 R = 3*(width*N)+2 := by
+  have hC := hf.scalars.source_pos
+  have hb := hf.scalars.balance
+  have ha := hf.scalars.alpha_pos
+  have hCF : source a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N))+
+      normalized digits < q N := by omega
+  refine ⟨fourBlocks N (source a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N)))
+    (normalized digits),fourBlocks_cast _ _ hC hCF,?_⟩
+  exact fourBlocks_population _ _ hC hCF hf.low_mask hf.high_mask
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPackingRank2011

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPackingRank2011
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPackingRank2011Checks
+
+open Jones1982 CurrentPackingRank2011 CurrentMasks2011
+  CurrentWordScalarWitness2011 CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordCopies2011
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+
+-- The binary exponent retains the full product, including N=0.
+example (N : ℕ) : q N = 2^(width*N) := q_binary N
+example : q 0 = 1 := by rw [q_binary]; simp
+
+-- Both literal adjusted masks are bounded in the smallest repunit window.
+example : lowPort*NativeMaskPopulation.repunit width 1+1 < q 1 ∧
+    highPort*NativeMaskPopulation.repunit width 1-1 < q 1 := repeated_mask_bounds
+
+-- These generic C,F values test ordinary signed/natural rank binding.
+-- They do not assert a one-cell tiling or positive F.
+private theorem one_lt_q_one : 1 < q 1 := by
+  rw [q_binary]
+  exact one_lt_pow₀ (by decide) (by decide)
+
+example : (fourBlocks 1 1 0 : ℤ) = rank 1 1 0 :=
+  fourBlocks_cast 1 0 (by decide) (by simpa using one_lt_q_one)
+example : σ 2 (fourBlocks 1 1 0) = 3*(width*1)+2 :=
+  fourBlocks_population 1 0 (by decide) (by simpa using one_lt_q_one) (by simp) (by simp)
+example : ((2*(width*1) : ℕ) : ℤ) < rank 1 1 0 :=
+  rank_gt_twice_window 1 0 (by decide) (by simpa using one_lt_q_one)
+
+-- The actual constructed source and F determine this same integer rank.
+example {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s : ℕ) (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy s k digits) :
+    ∃ R : ℕ,
+      (R : ℤ) = rank N (source a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N)))
+        (normalized digits) ∧ σ 2 R = 3*(width*N)+2 :=
+  packing_rank_population a dummy s k digits hf
+
+#print axioms q_binary
+#print axioms repeated_mask_bounds
+#print axioms repeated_mask_population
+#print axioms fourBlocks_cast
+#print axioms fourBlocks_ge_cube
+#print axioms rank_gt_twice_window
+#print axioms fourBlocks_population
+#print axioms packing_rank_population
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentPackingRank2011Checks

+## Exact mathematical binding
+
+`q_binary` retains the complete exponent `width*N`, with width 94517. The
+`rank` definition uses `windowRank q C F lowPort (highPort+beta) J`:
+the source fourth-port beta shift occurs exactly once. The mask used in the
+population calculation remains the unshifted `highPort*J-1`.
+
+Both repeated masks are proved strict representatives below q using their
+actual finite port inequalities and `beta*J+1=q`. The actual low-even and
+high-mod8=4 facts, plus the full finite combined population, supply the
+repeated mask population `width*N+2`, including both origin adjustments.
+
+Before casting the four-block natural integer, `fourBlocks_cast` proves the
+domains of every subtraction: C is positive, C+F<q, the positive high mask
+times the positive repunit is at least one, and the complement bounds follow.
+It then invokes the ordinary ring identity with the actual beta-J relation.
+Thus neither natural truncation nor a second high-mask shift is hidden.
+
+The generic population lemma applies with A=C-1. The exact identity
+`q-1-(C-1)=q-C` is established under C>0 and C+F<q. Both overlap-free masks
+are actual inputs in `fourBlocks_population`, and they are taken from the
+same `hf` in `packing_rank_population`. Source positivity and the balance
+C+F+alpha=q with positive alpha similarly come from that same packing. The
+returned R is explicitly the four-block integer, not an unrelated existential
+population witness.
+
+The lower bound uses the positive upper complement q-F-1, giving rank at
+least q cubed. With N nonzero and the actual positive width, q cubed exceeds
+twice `width*N`. This proof uses neither masks nor population nor Pell data.
+The intermediate natural lower-bound lemma also permits N=0, where its
+C>0 and C+F<q premises cannot simultaneously hold; the principal rank
+endpoints correctly require nonzero N.
+
+The focused N=1 examples bind signed/natural rank and population for C=1,F=0;
+they explicitly do not claim positive F or an actual one-cell marked tiling.
+The final constructed-word check keeps the actual source, marker orientation,
+normalized F, and one packing instance coherent.
+
+This packet does not yet prove rank congruences, rank-forced temporal
+exponentiation, a fresh Pell seed, a full31-coordinate source, or the
+polynomial converse.

+
+Root authored and read all138 main and49 check lines of `CurrentPackingRank2011`. This is an author receipt; the [independent isolated peer replay](current-packing-rank2011-lean-peer.md) separately reviews the new composition. Root also authored several reused packing/population prerequisites. Existing compiled dependencies were reused, not freshly rebuilt as a complete closure.
+
+The rank is the actual `windowRank q C F lowPort (highPort+beta) J`, including exactly one source high-port shift. The two mask operands remain the literal adjusted masks `lowPort*J+1` and `highPort*J−1`. Their strict bounds and combined population are derived from the actual finite ports and the same repunit balance. All natural-subtraction domains are established before the ordinary integer four-block identity is used. No alternate residue-defined port is substituted.
+
+For the same constructed packing, the explicit four-block natural R casts to that actual integer rank and has binary population `3*(94517*N)+2`. Neither a source-system zero nor a Pell population bound is supplied. The upper complement `q−F−1` is positive under C>0 and C+F<q, so the rank is at least q³ and exceeds twice the complete binary window94517*N. This lower bound requires no mask or Pell premise.
+
+Both final capped builds (`lake env lean -M6000 -j1`, `Elab.async false`) exited zero without diagnostics. The eight axiom reports contain only standard axioms; `q_binary` uses only `propext`. Focused checks retain N=0 for the exponent identity and arithmetic N=1/C=1/F=0 examples without asserting positive F or a nonexistent one-cell marked tiling. The final existential retains one particular actual source, normalization and packing instance.
